effect.name: Corona discharge and ionic wind
effect.function: move air or particles with an electric field
effect.statement: A sharp high-voltage point ionizes air; the ions drag air along and charge particles for collection.
conditions: specified electrodes, gas, spacing and observation location
corona ionization and charge transport established in the operating regime
electrical supply, current and discharge limits accounted for separately
effect.source: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-018-0707-9 ; repository-selected clause: Applied electrode voltage to ionic-wind velocity in a specified electroaerodynamic arrangement.

provenance.citation: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-018-0707-9 ; repository-authored selected clause and quantity declarations
provenance.license: MIT (repository-authored declaration; external reference text is not reproduced)

limitations: The selected wind clause does not type particle collection, infer a safe voltage range or establish thrust or efficiency.

model_assessment.selected_clause: Applied voltage to gas velocity with corona and charge transport supplied as conditions.
model_assessment.rationale: Separate the electrical-discharge clause from the ionic-wind mechanism. Ion generation, drift, momentum transfer and gas flow are coupled; the existing velocity clause does not model ionization current.

facets.name: Alternative electron-beam or photoelectron gas charge generation
Coupled particle detachment and flow transport
